title: 第二十一章 浸泡金龙血第二十二章 崇明花
slug: 震惊我的徒弟居然是女帝
content_zh:
大战之后藏剑阁也过上了安宁的日子。
这次收获了金龙妖圣的肉身和巨猿妖皇肉身。
除此之外还有近三十只其他的妖王肉身。
基本都是安妙菱击杀的，所以他们很长一段时间都不会缺肉吃了。
秦天也抽空利用精血加上灵药炼制了一些丹药。
这些丹药也能让大家的修炼速度更快一些。
还有就是。
之前的一战，秦天发现安妙菱没有太好的剑法。
于是秦天就把他最好的剑法，寂灭剑诀传给了安妙菱。
剑法有六式。
后面三式是至尊阶的剑法。
但是前三式只能算帝阶剑法。
教授过程中，秦天非常细心，可以说是手把手的教。
晚上秦天用金龙妖圣的精血，加上一些珍贵的灵药弄了一个药池。
这也是他想了很久的，之前几次去找妖皇都没找到。
这次好不容易有了更高级的妖圣血，他自然不会浪费这个淬炼肉体的机会。
药池弄好后，他就去把安妙菱和白筱如找了过来。
安妙菱一看到药池脸就红了，一起生活了这么久，她岂能不知道师傅的想法。
“徒儿快脱衣下去吧，这可是妖圣精血，泡一泡对你提升很大的。”秦天继续说道。
最后安妙菱只能脱掉外衣，露出里面粉红色的亵衣。

此时她那祸水般的小脸蛋已经出现嫣红，一双纤纤玉手环抱胸口，惹火的大长腿缓步向前，慢慢走到池水中坐下。
谁能想到，上一世杀伐果断的绝情女帝会露出如此小女儿姿态。
见安妙菱下去后，秦天穿个短裤然后抱起小狐狸就跳了下去。
此时安妙菱和小狐狸都不敢看秦天。
尤其是小狐狸还被秦天抱在怀里。
她很想反抗，但她知道是徒劳。
以前那么多帝境强者追求她，却连她手指头都没碰到。
现在倒好，便宜都被秦天占完了。
好在她也知道秦天不会做过太过的举动。
开始的尴尬期过了后，两人一狐就开始吸收金龙血来淬炼肉身。
还别说龙族的血淬体效果确实非常大。
就连他二重的万古不灭体都能感觉到明显的提升。
而安妙菱和白筱如的提升更大。
白筱如已经有进阶到半圣境二重的趋势。
content_en:
After the war, Hidden Sword Pavilion also lived a peaceful life.
This time, I harvested the body of the Golden Dragon Demon Saint and the body of the Giant Ape Demon Emperor.
In addition, there are nearly thirty other demon king bodies.
Most of them were killed by An Miaoling, so they would not be short of meat for a long time.
Qin Tian also took the time to refine some elixirs using blood essence and elixir.
These elixirs can also make everyone practice faster.
And there is.
In the previous battle, Qin Tian discovered that An Miaoling did not have very good swordsmanship.
So Qin Tian passed on his best swordsmanship, the Nirvana Sword Technique, to An Miaoling.
There are six styles of swordsmanship.
The next three moves are supreme level swordsmanship.
But the first three moves can only be regarded as emperor-level swordsmanship.
During the teaching process, Qin Tian was very attentive and taught step by step.
At night, Qin Tian made a medicine pool using the essence and blood of the Golden Dragon Demon Saint and some precious elixirs.
This is what he has been thinking about for a long time. He has not found the Demon King several times before.
This time he finally had a higher level of demon holy blood, so he naturally would not waste this opportunity to temper his body.
After the medicine pool was ready, he went to find An Miaoling and Bai Xiaoru.
An Miaoling blushed as soon as she saw Yaochi. How could she not know what her master was thinking after living together for so long.
"Disciple, please take off your clothes quickly. This is the blood of the Demon Saint. Taking a dip in it will greatly improve you." Qin Tian continued.
In the end, An Miaoling could only take off her coat, revealing the pink underwear underneath.
At this time, her troubled little face was already blushing, a pair of slender hands hugged her chest, her long and hot legs slowly moved forward, and she slowly walked to the pool and sat down.
Who would have thought that the cruel and decisive empress in her previous life would show such a little daughterly attitude.
After seeing An Miaoling go down, Qin Tian put on shorts, picked up the little fox and jumped down.
At this time, neither An Miaoling nor Little Fox dared to look at Qin Tian.
Especially the little fox was still held in Qin Tian's arms.
She wanted to resist, but she knew it was futile.
In the past, so many powerful men in the imperial realm pursued her, but they didn't even touch her finger.
It's good now, Qin Tian has taken all the advantages.
Fortunately, she also knew that Qin Tian would not do anything too extreme.
After the initial awkward period, the two began to absorb the blood of the golden dragon to temper their bodies.
Not to mention that the dragon clan's blood tempering effect is indeed very powerful.
Even his second-level eternal body can feel a significant improvement.
But An Miaoling and Bai Xiaoru improved even more.
Bai Xiaoru has the tendency to advance to the second level of Semi-Saint Realm.
